workAuthorization.note: Country-specific answers ('are you authorized to work in X') live in qa[], tag work_authorization:<country>. This block is background only — never answer a country-specific question directly from here.

location.note: Country-specific relocation answers live in qa[], tag relocation:<country>.

compensation.note: ANCHOR = expectedMin/expectedMax in defaultCurrency. Every other currency or contract form is DERIVED from it by the rules in compensation.derivation — do not escalate a new currency to the user, compute it and state the arithmetic at the confirmation pause.

currency.rule: Divide the anchor by the central-bank mid rate for the target currency, then round.

derivation.note: Recheck the FX rate whenever it is older than a few days. Keep worked examples so a reviewer can see how a number on a submitted form was reached.

strategy.note: Numbers salary-quote.mjs computes from. The rules are in apply-to-jobs SKILL.md § Money and in the script; edit numbers here, rules there.

experience.note: Compute using the resume repo's own rule for this: the earliest commercial software dev role in EXPERIENCE from the base CV. Never hardcode this number.

eeo.note: Personal and demographic questions (race, gender, marital status, veteran status, disability, pronouns) — when required and an opt-out exists ('Prefer not to say' or equivalent), pick it; no question to the user. Optional ones stay empty. Escalate only if mandatory with no opt-out and no qa[] answer.
